Actor Terrence Howard brings his private theories to episode 2152 of the Joe Rogan Experience. Howard claims the basic math taught in schools is wrong, starting with one times one, and he has built a whole system on the charge. His hour is wild by any measure.

He lays out his views on math, physics, and the shape of the universe for Rogan, who listens with a mix of wonder and doubt. The talk also touches on his acting career and his breaks with Hollywood. The episode is a famous piece of the show's open-door policy: a star's heresy, heard whole, for listeners to grade.
